name: NutriScan AI
tagline: Face and fingernail scans plus a short form give students cheap, specific nutrition advice.

awards: Best Health Hack by Sun Life
[MLH] Best Use of DigitalOcean Gradient AI

problem: Students on tight budgets and schedules find healthy eating hard, and nutrition apps ignore cost and time.
solution: Two quick camera scans are read by a multimodal model for visual cues, combined with a form, and turned into affordable food recommendations and goals.
demo_moment: Team-described: scan your face and nails and get a budget meal plan.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Health Hack by Sun Life” and “[MLH] Best Use of DigitalOcean Gradient AI” among 82 submissions.
Built around students' budget and time limits.
Visual health cues from a phone camera are unvalidated; a judge could question the medical claims.

lessons: Health demos impress, but say plainly what the scan cannot diagnose.
